snippet.title: SPLATCHINKO – Release Date Trailer | Chaotic Pachinko Roguelike
snippet.description:
Splatchinko is a pachinko roguelike where you launch eyes across chaotic boards, unlock ridiculous mutations and combine abilities into increasingly broken builds.

Bounce, multiply, grow, explode and trigger massive chain reactions as you travel through collapsing realities and destroy planets while chasing the love of your life.

Wishlist Splatchinko on Steam and play the free demo now.
